long_biography.plain_text:
The Breakthrough Prizes gave Yuri Milner a permanent institution for supporting fundamental science. Co-founded with other technology figures, the awards recognise advances in physics, life sciences and mathematics, placing researchers at the centre of a high-profile international ceremony.

Milner extended that work through the Breakthrough Initiatives. Separate programmes search for signs of technological civilisations, build instruments for listening across space and investigate concepts for uncrewed interstellar flight. The agenda returns him to questions raised by the quantum-field research he pursued before business and channels private capital into scientific projects with unusually long horizons.
